adjudication.rationale: The diff shows cancellation/deletion no longer relies on `evt.destinationCalendar` to decide which external calendar events to delete; it iterates over *all* `_calendar` references (`bookingToDelete.references.filter(...)` then `for (const reference ...)`) and calls `calendar.deleteEvent(uid, evt, externalCalendarId)` for each reference. Since `externalCalendarId` comes from each reference, additional team-member calendar events (if they were created and persisted as separate references) would still be deleted even if `evt.destinationCalendar` only contains one element. The finding’s claim that extra events are “never deleted/updated” is not verifiable from this diff and is contradicted by the new reference-loop deletion logic.
